def state(f):
    pegs=[]; cur=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        bs=n['boundary']; r=[p[0] for p in bs]; c=[p[1] for p in bs]
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>10: pegs.append((min(r),min(c)))
        if n['color']=='O': cur=(min(r),min(c),max(r),max(c))
    return sorted(pegs),cur
# lower panel slots + path
seg=current_frame.segmentation
low=[]
for n in seg['nodes']:
    bs=n['boundary']; r=[p[0] for p in bs]; c=[p[1] for p in bs]
    if n['color']=='w' and 44<=min(r)<=56: low.append((min(r),min(c),max(r),max(c)))
print("lower w-slots:",sorted(low))
print("before:", state(current_frame))
res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':20}])
print("after 4->2:", state(current_frame))
print("res:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('no_impact','gameplay_changed','level_completed','done')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
